description: Test a regex against a string and apply replacements. Operations: "test" — Find all matches of a regex pattern in a test string.; "replace" — Replace regex matches in a string.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: test: The test string to search. replace: The test string to transform.

operation.description: test — Find all matches of a regex pattern in a test string. replace — Replace regex matches in a string.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

flags.description: Regex flags, e.g. "gi". Used by: test, replace.

pattern.description: The regex pattern (JavaScript syntax). The API refuses nested quantifiers such as (a+)+, which can take exponential time. Used by: test, replace. Required by: test, replace.

name: regex
title: Regex Tester
